messages:
emma (pm): Heads-up — BigBank asked for a tenant-gated A/B on the new pricing guided flow. They want SLA-level availability but are sensitive to token costs. Need rollout plan that includes feature flag, canary, A/B metrics, and a cheap-model fallback. Who owns what?

lucas (sre): +1. Suggest per-tenant flag `pricing.tiers.ab_v2` with rollout weights. Start at 0.5% traffic, escalate on success. Also include a soft-fallback to a quantized variant if latency or error rate breaches.

aj (eng-sre): For SRE: require a circuit-breaker and per-tenant kill switch. Canary windows: 1h with 5m buckets. Key SLOs: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost delta. If any SLO crosses threshold for 3 consecutive buckets -> auto-failover to `model_v2-quant`.

rachel (sales): BigBank explicitly said "no customer-visible regressions". They need audit logs and an ops contact for the first 24h. Also will expect a comms plan if we flip fallback.

kai (custops): We'll need a playbook (runbook) with rollback steps and a sample `flag.yaml` for on-call. Also KMS key notes for telemetry export (customer requested). I can draft.

lucas (sre): Draft flag config (will implement as FF in LaunchDarkly/local flags):
```yaml
flag: pricing.tiers.ab_v2
default: off
rollout:
  - pct: 0.5
    cohort: random
  - pct: 5
    cohort: canary
conditions:
  - if: tenant == "bigbank"
    override: true
fallback: model_v2-quant
```

aj (eng-sre): Nice. A couple infra notes:
- Telemetry: wire `canary.tag=pricing_ab_v2` on traces.
- Eval set: run golden prompts every 15m against both variants during canary.
- Circuit-breaker config: `error_rate>0.5%` OR `p95_latency > 1200ms` for 3 buckets -> trigger fallback.

emma (pm): Proposed gating metrics for go/no-go after initial 1h canary: conversion lift >= +2% OR no regression beyond noise band, p95 latency delta <= +150ms, 5xx delta <= +0.1%. If not met, rollback.

rachel (sales): Who signs off on the customer-facing SLA change? Ops or product? BigBank legal will want a note.

kai (custops): Ops needs the contact; assign someone to monitor first 4h. I can be on standby but prefer engineering on-call primary.

aj (eng-sre): We'll add an alert channel and a decked webhook to the BigBank SRE-vendor channel for any auto-fallback events. Deploy-bot pls note pipeline checks.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered: `pricing-ab-v2/canary` -> e2e tests -> canary-deploy (dry-run)

lucas (sre): Implementation notes: feature flag + rollout engine supports per-tenant weights. We'll also add a fast-path routing rule so fallback to quantized model doesn't requeue requests to expensive infra. Config snippet for routing: `route.policy: prefer_low_cost_if_fallback=true`.

emma (pm): Action items: 1) Lucas implement flag + routing rule; 2) Aj add CB + alerts + golden eval; 3) Kai draft runbook & KMS notes; 4) Rachel prepare customer comms and legal blurb. Target timeline: initial canary 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC.

rachel (sales): Put BigBank on the calendar for a pre-rollout call Tue 2026-04-02. I'll handle legal.

kai (custops): I'll open the runbook PR today.

aj (eng-sre): Will push circuit-breaker config by EOD.

lucas (sre): Flag PR by EOD; will add a local simulation harness to replay requests and estimate cost delta.

emma (pm): OK team — please react with :thumbsup: when your PRs are linked and we can close this thread. :eyes:

rachel (sales): :thumbsup:

kai (custops): :thumbsup:

aj (eng-sre): :thumbsup:

lucas (sre): :thumbsup:

emma (pm): Thanks — closing once PRs are linked.
